Guides / Battle & team / Bosses

Bosses

A boss every 35 encounters: kinds, shields, traits and rewards.

Dynamax or GigantamaxShieldsTraitsRewards

Every 35 encounters a boss shows up on your island: an Alpha, a Mega, a Dynamax / Gigantamax or a Mega Alpha, depending on the island. Each island's Gym needs that island's boss count first. A boss that beats you waits for a rematch.

KindStatsHPJoins youIslands
ALPHA×1.25×2.1515%Dewleaf Town, Sunny Shore, Ashen Peak, Misty Pyre, Frostveil Peak, Skyhigh Cliffs, Voltage Works
MEGA×1.05×2.1510%Sunny Shore, Ashen Peak, Misty Pyre, Frostveil Peak, Skyhigh Cliffs, Voltage Works, Dragonspire
DYNAMAX / GIGANTAMAX×1.15×3.412%Ashen Peak, Misty Pyre, Frostveil Peak, Skyhigh Cliffs, Voltage Works, Dragonspire
MEGA ALPHA×1.3×2.5512%Ashen Peak, Misty Pyre, Frostveil Peak, Skyhigh Cliffs, Voltage Works, Dragonspire

Bosses are a final form from the island (Megas are any Mega-capable non-legendary, local ones first; Dynamax / Gigantamax picks a strong one). Level: a step above your strongest Pokémon (+2, +4 for Dynamax / Gigantamax / Mega Alpha), at least the island's low + 3, at most its top + 8 and your cap + 1.

Dynamax or Gigantamax

Giant bosses are one kind inside the game (same odds, same rewards, same chance to join you). The banner says GIGANTAMAX only for the 32 species that really have a Gigantamax form; every other giant boss is a DYNAMAX one, with a softer red look.

Real Gigantamax species (32)
VenusaurCharizardBlastoiseButterfreePikachuMeowthMachampGengarKinglerLaprasEeveeSnorlaxGarbodorMelmetalRillaboomCinderaceInteleonCorviknightOrbeetleDrednawCoalossalFlappleAppletunSandacondaToxtricityCentiskorchHattereneGrimmsnarlAlcremieCopperajahDuraludonUrshifu

Shields

  • A boss has a shield (40% of your damage soaks into it). Break Pokémon crack it from the bench every 2 turns; any lead chips it.
  • When it breaks, the boss is staggered for 3 turns (5 with Binding Band): your hits deal ×1.5 (Scope Lens: ×2.1). Then the shield grows back at half (a quarter with Binding Band).
  • Tactics are automatic: a Break steps in while the shield is up, the hardest-hitting DPS when it breaks, a hurt lead falls back.

Traits

From Ashen Peak on, every boss has a trait (Dewleaf Town 35%, Sunny Shore 60%):

TraitWhat it doesBring
Iron ShellA huge shield that soaks most of your damage and comes back full after it breaks.Bring Break Pokémon (two is best)
FuryEvery 3 turns it lashes out for 15% of your lead's HP.Bring Support Pokémon to heal through it
EnrageAfter 18 turns it enrages, and its attacks keep growing.Bring DPS with super-effective moves and finish it fast

Rewards

  • Money: level × 12 (× Amulet Coin, Lucky, Luck Incense).
  • Rare Candy 20% of the time (Dynamax / Gigantamax always).
  • Mega and Mega Alpha bosses always drop their Mega Stone; Dynamax / Gigantamax always leaves a Big Nugget.
  • A random held item 40% of the time (Dynamax / Gigantamax always).
  • Sometimes the beaten boss joins you (chance above): an Alpha keeps its Alpha power.
  • Losses come with up to 3 tips on what to change (more Break, more Support, better types, more Power).
